thread:
anna_sales: Heads-up — big POC with FinCorp (EU-based) just moved to next stage. They want a 4-week POC. Need help aligning deployment mode, success criteria, and security ask.

mike_solutions: Nice. Quick Qs: primary workload = customer support assistant (chat + retrieval), expected peak ~50 rps, avg session length ~120 tokens, need embeddings for search. Data residency must be EU.

anna_sales: Correct. Also they asked about committed pricing for Dedicated vs pay-as-you-go for Hosted during POC. And they're leaning toward a private deployment if we can meet SOC2 + KMS + network diagram.

jess_research: For success criteria let's propose: 1) p95 latency <200ms for generate endpoint (EU region), 2) embedding recall @5 >= 0.82 on their eval set, 3) end-to-end cost <$X per 1k sessions (we'll compute), and 4) passing security questionnaire answers + diagram. Thoughts?

sam_infra: Given 50 rps and latency SLO, Dedicated in eu-west1 (or GCP eu-west) is the predictable choice. Hosted could work for fast start but risk of noisy neighbors and cross-region hops if we can't pin region. Private (VPC) is only needed if they insist on on-prem or strict network isolation — it's heavier (ops + 2-3 week infra prep).

mike_solutions: Can we run a Hosted POC scoped to eu-west to validate model quality first, then flip to Dedicated for perf acceptance if they commit? That shortens start time and reduces upfront cost.

sam_infra: Yes — we can route requests to eu-west hosted fleet for the POC. But call out two caveats: 1) Hosted does not give dedicated GPU tail latency guarantees; 2) If they require KMS + private peering, Hosted won't satisfy that.

security_bot: Security checklist update: FinCorp requires SOC2 Type II, customer-managed KMS, audit logs retention 1yr, IP allowlist & VPC peering, and penetration-test report. We have SOC2 and logging covered; KMS + peering require Dedicated or Private.

anna_sales: Good call. So plan A: Hosted (eu-west) for week 1-2 for model/quality evals + prompt tuning. Plan B: switch to Dedicated eu-west (reserved capacity) for week 3-4 for load/latency certs if they like quality. Plan C: Private only if they insist on KMS/peering.

jess_research: For evals, ask FinCorp to provide a labeled eval set (200 queries) and a few representative prompt templates. We'll run: embedding recall, generation ROUGE/BLEU-ish checks, and human rating on 30 sample sessions. Put these in the SOW.

mike_solutions: Pricing note to share with buyer: Hosted POC = pay-as-you-go with estimated tokens + embeddings cost; Dedicated short-term = 4-week reserved pool (pro-rate), we can offer a discounted trial rate for the POC commit. I'll draft numbers.

sam_infra: Ops checklist for Dedicated switch: 1) capacity request (GPUs) + 2) region eu-west1, 2) model image hash & quantization profile, 3) canary policy set to 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 4h, 4) KV cache prewarm with retriever snapshots. Example canary config: ```canary: {"steps": [10,50,100], "window": "4h"}```

jess_research: Also include prompt eval harness and a regression alert: baseline generation metrics from Hosted phase -> fail POC if embedding recall drops >4% or p95 latency >200ms on Dedicated.

security_bot: Add security deliverables to SOW: network diagram, KMS plan (if Dedicated: integrate with customer KMS via mutual TLS), and signed AAD for penetration test window.

anna_sales: Ok everyone — next steps: Mike to send pricing draft by EOD Tuesday; Jess to prepare eval harness request + template prompts; Sam to confirm Dedicated capacity lead times and estimated costs; Security to send checklist items we must answer in the questionnaire. I'll schedule a call with FinCorp for Wednesday. :thumbsup:

mike_solutions: On it. I'll also include two options in the quote: (A) Hosted POC 2w + Dedicated 2w, (B) Dedicated-only 4w.

sam_infra: I can provision Dedicated test pool in ~5 business days once capacity is approved. If we need Private, add ~10-14 business days.

jess_research: I'll send the eval template and a sample prompt set in the thread before the call.

security_bot: Checklist doc: https://internal.redwood/security/fin_screener (will update with KMS/peering details).

anna_sales: Perfect. Meeting scheduled Wed 11:00 CET. Assigning owners in the calendar invite. Thanks team. :pray:
